content: केरलः (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a country (in the south of India, the modern Malabar) and its inhabitants; <ls>Māl. 6. 19</ls>; भयोत्सृष्टविभूषाणां तेन केरलयोषिताम् <ls>R. 4. 54</ls>. .{@-ली@} .²1 A woman of the Kerala country; कर्णाटीनां मुषितमुरलीकेरलीहारलीलः (राजेन्द्रकर्णपूरः). .²2 Astronomical science. .²3 A Hora or period of time equal to one hour.
